_comment: Recraft vector logo prompt templates. Variables: {brand}, {subject}, {colors}, {bg}, {shape_block}, {no_text}.
shape_block: Keep the mark fully inside a clean {shape} container.

no_text.icon_only: No text, letters, words, or numbers.
no_text.with_brand: The ONLY text allowed is exactly "{brand}" with correct spelling.
no_text.text_only: The ONLY text allowed is exactly "{brand}". No icons or symbols.

icon_only.minimal_geometric: Minimal geometric vector logo of {subject}. Keep the exact subject and spatial relationship recognizable, with a strong simple silhouette and clean flat shapes. Colors: {colors}. Background: {bg}. {shape_block} Crisp SVG paths. {no_text}
icon_only.abstract: Abstract vector logo of {subject}. Keep the subject recognizable before abstraction; use simple flat planes and a clear silhouette. Colors: {colors}. Background: {bg}. {shape_block} Avoid unrelated marks. Crisp SVG paths. {no_text}
icon_only.monoline: Monoline vector logo of {subject}. Keep the subject and spatial relationship readable in an elegant continuous-line icon. Colors: {colors}. Background: {bg}. {shape_block} Crisp SVG paths. {no_text}
icon_only.negative_space: Negative-space vector logo of {subject}. Keep the subject readable, with one clear hidden-shape idea and minimal flat geometry. Colors: {colors}. Background: {bg}. {shape_block} Crisp SVG paths. {no_text}
icon_only.tech_gradient: Modern gradient vector logo of {subject}. Keep the subject recognizable, with smooth geometric shapes and controlled gradient fills. Colors: {colors}. Background: {bg}. {shape_block} Crisp SVG paths. {no_text}
icon_only.evergreen_silhouette: Professional evergreen forest silhouette vector logo of {subject}. Create a polished cluster of conifer, pine, and fir trees with varied heights, sharp readable branch edges, a clean unified black silhouette, and a subtle ground base. Use solid black unless user colors override. Background: {bg}. {shape_block} Premium outdoor brand mark, balanced centered composition, crisp SVG paths, no messy blobs, no photorealism, no texture. {no_text}

text_only.modern_sans: Text-only vector wordmark logo for "{brand}" in a modern sans-serif style. Clean letterforms, balanced spacing, contemporary geometry. Colors: {colors}. Background: {bg}. {shape_block} No icons or symbols. Crisp SVG-friendly paths and clean Bezier curves.
text_only.bold_geometric: Text-only vector wordmark logo for "{brand}" in a bold geometric sans-serif style. Strong structure, heavy weight, confident presence. Colors: {colors}. Background: {bg}. {shape_block} No icons or symbols. Crisp SVG-friendly paths and clean Bezier curves.
text_only.elegant_serif: Text-only vector wordmark logo for "{brand}" in an elegant serif style. Refined contrast, graceful terminals, premium editorial tone. Colors: {colors}. Background: {bg}. {shape_block} No icons or symbols. Crisp SVG-friendly paths and clean Bezier curves.
text_only.script_signature: Text-only vector wordmark logo for "{brand}" in a script signature style. Flowing strokes and handcrafted rhythm. Colors: {colors}. Background: {bg}. {shape_block} No icons or symbols. Crisp SVG-friendly paths and clean Bezier curves.
text_only.tech_mono: Text-only vector wordmark logo for "{brand}" in a technical monospaced style. Precise spacing, engineered rhythm, digital systems aesthetic. Colors: {colors}. Background: {bg}. {shape_block} No icons or symbols. Crisp SVG-friendly paths and clean Bezier curves.
text_only.minimal_light: Text-only vector wordmark logo for "{brand}" in a minimal light-weight sans-serif style. Thin strokes, airy spacing, understated look. Colors: {colors}. Background: {bg}. {shape_block} No icons or symbols. Crisp SVG-friendly paths and clean Bezier curves.
